messages:
anna.peopleops: Quick pack for managers — 60s coaching + one-line goals + short feedback prompts. Drop any edits.

priya.manager: love this, can we get a single-line goal formula I can drop into 1:1s?

anna.peopleops: yup — use this pattern (works for ICs and managers):
```
Goal: [Outcome] measured by [metric] by [date]
Example: Reduce p99 latency by 30% measured by end-to-end p99 from 420ms to <=300ms by 2026-06-30
```

leo.eng: can you make a version for exploratory/qualitative work?

anna.peopleops: sure — qualitative template:
```
Goal: [Area of impact] demonstrated by [concrete deliverable / evidence] by [date]
Example: Improve search relevance demonstrated by A/B test showing +7% click-through on top-3 results by 2026-06-30
```

sam.ic: also need tiny feedback prompts for managers — something I can paste quickly.

anna.peopleops: added snack prompts below; copy/paste into Slack or notes.
- 1-line praise: "Great job on [deliverable]. Your work on [specific] helped [impact]."
- 1-line coaching: "Nice progress — consider [specific action] to improve [outcome]."
- 1-line redirect: "Let's pair on [task] this week to unblock the next step."

jess.hrbp: can we add a quick performance calibration note? one sentence to put in manager recs.

anna.peopleops: yep — calibration line:
"Evidence: [key results / artifacts]. Recommendation: [rating] with notes on stretch areas."

cody-recruiter: this is awesome — can we have a 30s new-hire goal starter too?

anna.peopleops: new-hire starter:
```
30-day: Onboard and deliver small bugfix or doc improvement to learn the codebase.
60-day: Deliver a visible contribution (PR) that touches core flow and demonstrates ownership.
90-day: Lead a small feature/bug from design to rollout and own post-launch metrics.
```

priya.manager: perfect — thanks! I'll use these in tomorrow's sync :raised_hands: 

pulse-bot: Reminder scheduled: add these templates to the manager toolkit page — due 2026-03-25

anna.peopleops: will follow up with a condensed PDF and Notion snippet. If anyone wants alternate phrasings, ping me.
